_source: Captured LIVE 2026-09-16 from https://phl.carto.com/api/v2/sql (table opa_properties_public), routed through Dialysis_DB pg_net because this sandbox has no direct egress to phl.carto.com (the agent proxy answers 403 to CONNECT). Harris fixtures are the operator-capture shape described in OWNERGAP1 §9 — HCAD is NOT fetched by this build (search.hcad.org answered 403 with the Cloudflare managed challenge on the same day).
_why_fixtures: npm test is hermetic by guard (test/_helpers/net-guard.mjs throws on any non-loopback host). These are the real bytes the real query returned, so the matcher is exercised against production data without a test ever reaching a real host.

3823 Market St.note: range_contains AND parity. 3823 is odd: it is inside 3817-39 (odd side, RALSTON) and NOT inside 3816-40 (even side, UNIVERSITY CITY). Without the parity rule both match, two distinct owners appear, and a resolvable property is wrongly refused as multi-parcel.

3300 Henry Ave.note: MULTI-PARCEL — Falls Center. Six rows, five distinct owners. Must refuse.

2910 South 70th St.note: Two parcels, ONE owner (2910R is the rear lot). Unambiguous — the answer is the same either way — so this resolves rather than refusing.

834 Walnut St.note: range_contains into a range with FOUR distinct owners (800-34 WALNUT ST). Correctly refused — containment is not a licence to guess.

100 E. Lehigh Ave..note: Leading DIRECTIONAL. The first cut of normalizeAddress ate the `E` as a house letter and this read as no_matching_record.

4190 City Avenue, Suite 124.note: range_contains at the exact range END (4182-90). Also carries `4100 CITY AVE => ABC INC` — a REAL Philadelphia owner whose name trips the OWNERGAP1 fabrication guard.

4508 City Line Ave..note: STREET ALIAS (CITY LINE AVE -> CITY AVE) widens the search and the house number then correctly REFUSES: 4508 is not 4500 and 4500 is not a range. An alias must widen what is searched, never what may be written.

3401 Fox St, Building 5.note: Genuine no-record: the city returns nothing on this street in band.
